question: Which supreme deities are included among those who react to the practitioner?
premises: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are named
Other gods are included by the relative clause
These gods are described as the best among gods
inference: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and other foremost gods are the ones in view.
plain_english: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and those gods who are the best among the gods.
